registration.title: Register new user account

import.title: Import credentials
import.instructions: Paste the credentials from your first device. The app will lock and you'll need to unlock with your password.
import.warningTitle: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: You must use the SAME password on all devices!

editorTab.quickCommandsHelp: Type slash commands like /now, /date, /time, /uuid, or /hr to quickly insert content. Commands expand when followed by space or enter.
editorTab.syntaxHelp: Select which programming languages to enable for syntax highlighting in Markdown code blocks and previews. Core languages are always enabled.

editorTab.noCommands: No commands configured. Click "Add command" to create one.

syncTab.syncDisabledDetails: When disabled, Jottery will not make any network requests to sync servers. All your notes remain completely local to this device.
syncTab.toEnableSync: To enable sync: Toggle the switch above and configure your sync server.
syncTab.privacyNote: Privacy: Even when enabled, all notes are end-to-end encrypted. The sync server cannot read your content.

fullSync.title: Full Sync
fullSync.description: Push ALL notes to the server, regardless of their sync status. Use this if notes are out of sync or after importing data.

syncTab.credentialsHelp: Click to display credentials as text. Use "Use Existing Credentials" on other devices to import.
syncTab.samePasswordWarning: All devices must use the SAME password to decrypt notes!

accountManagement.title: Manage Your Account
accountManagement.loginPrompt: Log in to view your account information and manage your synced notes.
accountManagement.privacyDescription: All your notes are end-to-end encrypted. The server cannot read your content.
accountManagement.deleteNotesDescription: Delete all your notes from the sync server. This action cannot be undone. Your local notes will NOT be deleted.

advancedTab.exportDescription: Export notes as decrypted JSON. Import will merge notes with existing data.
advancedTab.terminalClientDescription: Use the terminal client to access your notes from the command line
advancedTab.deleteAllDataWarning: This will permanently delete ALL notes, settings, and encryption keys. This action cannot be undone.

aboutTab.documentationDescription: Learn how to use Jottery effectively
aboutTab.terminalClientDescription: Access your notes from the command line with the Jottery terminal client. The TUI provides a fast, keyboard-driven interface for managing your notes.
aboutTab.terminalClientDownload: Download the terminal client from the Advanced tab.
aboutTab.aboutDescription: Jottery is a privacy-focused, self-hosted scratch pad application for capturing, organizing, and searching notes with rich content, syntax highlighting, and encryption.

settings.openLinksInNewTab: Open External Links in New Tab
settings.openLinksInNewTabDescription: When enabled, links to external websites in markdown preview will open in a new browser tab instead of navigating away from Jottery
settings.persistSessionDescription: Keep your session active when refreshing the page. Password is stored temporarily in your browser's session storage.
settings.persistSessionNote: More secure than 'Remember Password' - expires automatically and clears when you close the tab.
settings.persistSessionUnavailable: Session storage is not available (file:// URL or browser privacy settings).
settings.persistSessionTimeoutDescription: Session expires after this many minutes. Range: 5-480.

unlock.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
unlock.warning: Important: Your password cannot be recovered. If you lose it, your data will be permanently inaccessible.
unlock.failedAttempts: Incorrect password. After 3 failed attempts, you may need to delete the database and start over.
unlock.storedPasswordInvalid: Stored password is invalid. Please re-enter your password.

privateEncrypted.title: 🔒 Private & Encrypted
privateEncrypted.description: Jottery is a privacy-focused note-taking app. All your notes are encrypted locally on your device using your master password. No one can read your notes without your password—not even if they access your device's storage.

localFirst.title: 💾 Local-First Storage
localFirst.description: Your notes are stored directly in your browser's local database. Jottery works completely offline and doesn't require an internet connection or account to use.

optionalSync.title: ☁️ Optional Sync Server
optionalSync.description: Want to sync across devices? Jottery can optionally sync with a self-hosted server. Your notes and tags are encrypted before syncing—the server only stores encrypted data it cannot read.

selfHosting.title: 🏠 Self-Hosting
selfHosting.description: Want to run your own sync server? Jottery is open source and easy to self-host.

syncWarning.title: ⚠️ Sync Recommended
syncWarning.description: Running Jottery without sync capability is not recommended. Clearing your browser cache can delete the underlying database. Take the time to set up sync capability—the Jottery system is fully open source and self-hostable.

This will disconnect this device from the sync server and clear all sync credentials.

Your local notes will remain on this device and will NOT be deleted.
